wwo.name: Guangzhou
wwo.method: The 1900 Yuedong map records the street and water relationships. The pre-1900 Kerr plate corroborates stable features. Schnock's 1907 survey supplies readable reference positions for alignments already shown in 1900. Ordinary Xiguan housing and courts are inferred inside the mapped blocks. The old West Gate connects toward the north side of the Xiguan creek, and the southern gates connect through the former New City and Lower Xiguan toward Shamian's West Bridge. The widening and arcades of Enning Road are excluded.

registration.model: Five approximate landmark correspondences place the 2000 by 1600 Schnock consultation copy in WGS84/UTM 49N with a least-squares affine. Lines shared with the 1900 map are traced in that registration. Printed landmarks can occupy more than one control point's residual.

Five-Story Pavilion, the east summit of the paired hills in the north wall

registration.limitation: The leave-one-out residual ranges from about 85 m to 344 m. No surveyed position or individual building footprint is implied.

limitations: The West Bridge is the confirmed Shamian crossing in this revision. The two editions differ in the east crossing. That geometry remains unresolved.

The plan classifies only mapped blocks, court parcels and water. The bounds of the historic Pearl River demonstration reach delimit source support. Small lanes outside the registered portions remain unclassified.

All generated forms and heights are inferred. No business, dock operation or traffic is assigned. Shamian's garden lots are separated from the dense Xiguan frontage. Colonial facades are not independently reconstructed by the existing profile.
The approximate 1900 relation at the ordinary anchor is the Xiguan creek and housing seam. Today's Enning roadway alignment cannot be used as a Qing survey.

sources.precision: Period topology, settlement extent, named districts and shared alignments. This edition is not metrically rectified. The atlas owner is Guangdong Provincial Archives.

sources.precision: F. Schnock, Canton with Suburbs and Honam, printed 1:5,000. The detailed copy is 2000 by 1600 pixels. Coordinate control only for common pre-1901 features. See residuals.

sources.date: Kerr guide plate attributed to 1880. Commons scan labelled 1890.
sources.licence: Public Domain Mark on the Commons record.
sources.precision: Pre-1900 corroboration for the walled city, Shamian street grid, the Pearl River and Honam temple site. Approximate historical plate date. Not used to date individual features.

candidate_routes.scope: Common mapped road and urban blocks to the north bank of the creek. The ordinary anchor also reads the opposite inner bend as housing.
Mapped gate links, lower street bands and Shamian West Bridge. The Pearl channel continues between the sourced banks beyond the bridge.
